create_svm_classifier: create a linear SVM classifier using scikit-learn's svm.SVC with configurable C penalty
plot_svm_margin: plot SVM separating hyperplane and margin lines for different C parameter values
fit_svm_model: fit a linear SVM model on 2D separable data and extract support vectors
visualize_decision_function: visualize the SVM decision function as a contour plot over a meshgrid
compare_regularization: compare unregularized and regularized SVM margin behavior by varying C parameter
